name: dev-credentials
description: Machine-level, agent-readable dev credentials for testing, for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Provides a skill for creating and consuming a single machine-level credentials file that an agent may read when it needs a working API key to run or test something, without touching the project's real secrets.
defaultPrompt: Set up the dev credentials file so I can paste a test key into it.
Use the dev credentials to run this against a real model.
